# docs — generated Swagger/OpenAPI spec

**Generated by `swag init` — do not hand-edit.** Contains `docs.go` (imported by `main.go` as `_ "gcs/docs"` to register the spec), `swagger.json`, and `swagger.yaml`.

Regenerate after changing any `@Summary`/`@Router`-style annotation in `internal/handlers/handlers.go` or the general API block above `func main()` in `cmd/server/main.go`:

```sh
# from apps/server
swag init -g cmd/server/main.go
```

`./run.sh` at the repo root does this automatically before starting the backend, if the `swag` CLI is available (`go install github.com/swaggo/swag/cmd/swag@latest`).

Served at runtime via `echo-swagger` at `GET /swagger/index.html` (UI) and `GET /swagger/doc.json` (raw spec).
